name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs offers text-to-speech, speech-to-text, sound effects, voice design and music, sold as credit-based plans from Free to Enterprise.
features: Text to speech and speech to text
Sound effects, voice design and music
Credits that roll over for up to two months
strengths: Annual billing is described as two months free
limitations: Downgrading or cancelling forfeits unused credits at the end of the cycle
Introductory offers appear on Starter and Creator and the end date is shown inconsistently

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: Regular price $6 per month on monthly billing; the page showed an introductory $1 for the first month (until Nov 1). 30k credits per month.

plans.name: Creator
plans.note: Regular price $22 per month on monthly billing; the page showed $11 for the first month. 121k credits per month.

free.details: 10k credits per month, with Text to Speech, Speech to Text, Sound Effects, Voice Design, Music, Productions, Image and 3 Studio projects.

api.summary: A separate API pricing page exists. For some models the page states discounted API usage at between 0.5 and 1 credit per character.

pricing.regional: Prices exclude all taxes, levies and duties. Regional pricing: not stated. Payment methods: card, Apple Pay, Google Pay.
